# Daily Briefing – Sunday 25 October

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training, 4,834 steps, and calories burned sitting right at 2,353 kcal, which actually aligned well with your 2,300 target. A genuinely solid rest day from an energy balance perspective.

Recovery is mixed. Your HRV at 94ms is sitting below your 98-120ms baseline, and combined with a stress score of 48/100, your body is signalling it hasn't fully bounced back yet. Your resting HR of 50 bpm is a positive sign though — your cardiovascular base looks strong.

Given the suppressed HRV, keep today easy if you're training — think Zone 2 or a relaxed walk rather than anything intense. On nutrition, prioritise hitting that 175g protein today; it directly supports recovery and helps preserve muscle while you're working toward that 80-85kg target. Don't let a rest day become a reason to undereat.
